title: Half Day Pontoon Boat Rental Myrtle Beach Grande Dunes
blurb:
This isn’t your average pontoon rental—our tritoons are upgraded with three pontoons for a noticeably smoother, more stable, and safer ride, making them some of the best boats available in the area. You get the freedom to captain your own adventure on the Intracoastal Waterway, without needing a boating license, plus the option to hire a captain if you prefer a fully relaxed experience.

With spacious seating for larger groups, pet-friendly policies, and easy-to-use controls, this experience is designed for both beginners and seasoned boaters. Combined with top-quality equipment and a simple, flexible rental process, it’s a stress-free way to explore the water on your own terms.
